title: Kernel of a two-term complex with free degree-0 term commutes with base change when Tor_1 and Tor_2 of the cokernel vanish
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring, $C$ a $B$-module, and $\delta:N_1\to N_0$ a homomorphism of $B$-modules with $N_0$ a free $B$-module; put $H_1=\ker\delta$ and $H_0=\operatorname{coker}\delta$. If $\operatorname{Tor}^B_1(H_0,C)=0$ and $\operatorname{Tor}^B_2(H_0,C)=0$ [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], then the $B$-linear map $H_1\otimes_BC\to\ker(\delta\otimes\mathrm{id}_C:N_1\otimes_BC\to N_0\otimes_BC)$, $h\otimes c\mapsto h\otimes c$ (induced by the inclusion $H_1\subseteq N_1$; it lands in the kernel since $\delta(h)=0$), is an isomorphism. (If $C$ is a $B$-algebra, this map is $C$-linear.)
